meta_intent: Adopt an existing partially completed project, reconstruct and preserve its history, reconcile its roadmap, and finish only genuine remaining work.
question: Does the V0 prompt satisfactorily fulfill its proposed meta-intent in its intended context?
interpretation: The V0 adoption-specific protocol instructs inspecting past work, preserving decisions, reconciling an existing roadmap and completion baseline, implementing only legitimate remaining work, and stopping when done. The identified absence of a dedicated canonical adoption situation concerns linked ontology coverage, not the instructions in V0.
applicable_preconditions: The specified project already exists and has partial progress or established decisions.
Available project history and tests can be inspected, with missing evidence disclosed.
Stewardship authorization and repository permissions are known.
failure_conditions: Never reset valid prior progress or replace an adequate existing roadmap.
Never invent unrelated tasks or widen the original project objective.
If complete, stop instead of beginning a new round.
If history is missing, report uncertainty rather than inventing reconstruction.
source_text_evidence: This is not a new project.
Never reset progress to zero merely because stewardship is beginning.
Continue only if legitimate unfinished work remains. If the project is already verified complete, stop.
